episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Joss Whedon, the creative genius behind the feature film "Marvel's The Avengers," one of the highest grossing films of all time, and of the iconic television series "Buffy The Vampire Slayer," has co-created "Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.," a dynamic, action-packed one-hour drama that brings back Agent Phil Coulson to lead a team of highly skilled agents to investigate extra-normal and super human people and events worldwide.

Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents travel to Peru to investigate an object of unknown origin, codenamed 0-8-4. But when he runs into Comandante Camilla Reyes, more than just sparks fly at 30,000 feet.

episodes.title: The Asset
episodes.summary: When the brilliant scientist Dr. Franklin Hall is kidnapped, Agent Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents must race against the clock to locate him. Skye is their only way in -- pushing the team to their limits when the entire plan turns upside-down.

episodes.title: Eye Spy
episodes.summary: Agent Coulson and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team try to track down a mysterious woman who has single-handedly committed numerous high-stakes heists. But when the woman's identity is revealed, a troubling secret stands to ruin Coulson.

episodes.title: Girl in the Flower Dress
episodes.summary: An elusive girl in a flower dress may hold the key to the mystery that brings Coulson and team to Asia to rescue a young man with an unusual and dangerous power. Meanwhile, Skye has a secret that jeopardizes her relationship with the team right when they need her most.

episodes.title: FZZT
episodes.summary: When floating bodies turn up, Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D must hunt down an elusive killer. No one is safe -- not even the team.

episodes.title: The Hub
episodes.summary: Dangerous secrets are being kept from Coulson's team and he works the system to save Ward and Fitz when they are sent on a Level 8 classified mission that may end in tragedy.

episodes.title: The Well
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the events chronicled in the feature film THOR: THE DARK WORLD, Coulson and The Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. pick up the pieces -- one of which threatens to destroy a member of the team.

episodes.title: Repairs
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team are haunted by a mysterious force that threatens to destroy them all, and only a secret from May's past can save them.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.summary: In a shocking cliffhanger episode, Coulson takes the war back to Centipede, and this time he brings in Mike Peterson for some super-soldier support. As they get closer to the truth, startling secrets are revealed and an unexpected twist threatens the team.

episodes.title: The Magical Place
episodes.summary: Coulson uncovers vital information about the mystery of his death, but, with Centipede out for blood, this knowledge may come at the cost of one of the team.

episodes.title: Seeds
episodes.summary: Coulson and May uncover startling information about Skye's past, while the team is swept into a storm at S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy.

episodes.title: T.R.A.C.K.S.
episodes.summary: Hot on the trail of the Clairvoyant, Coulson and his team board a mystery train that seems to be headed for certain death.

episodes.title: T.A.H.I.T.I.
episodes.summary: Coulson goes on the attack to save Skye - enlisting the aid of Ward's former S.O. John Garrett -- and uncovers shocking truths about his own life and S.H.I.E.L.D..

episodes.title: Yes Men
episodes.summary: When Coulson and his team are attacked by Lorelei - a deadly seductress who escaped from Asgard - Thor's Lady Sif, her longtime nemesis, steps in to try to save them.

episodes.title: End of the Beginning
episodes.summary: Agents Garrett and Triplett are back to help Coulson's team track down S.H.I.E.L.D.'S nefarious enemy - the Clairvoyant. But will Deathlok destroy them all to protect his master's identity?

episodes.title: Turn, Turn, Turn
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team find themselves without anyone they can trust, only to discover that they are trapped with a traitor in their midst.

episodes.title: Providence
episodes.summary: With Colonel Glenn Talbot now on their trail, Coulson and his team seek refuge in the last place anyone would look, where they begin to uncover S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most dangerous secrets -- secrets that could destroy them all.

episodes.title: The Only Light in the Darkness
episodes.summary: With their world turned upside down, Coulson races to save the life of his one true love as the mystery of "The Cellist," which began in Marvel's The Avengers.

episodes.title: Nothing Personal
episodes.summary: Just when there's no one left to trust, Agent Maria Hill -- from "Marvel's The Avengers" and "Marvel's Captain America: The Winter Solider" -- returns to team up with Coulson as S.H.I.E.L.D. is being destroyed around them.

episodes.title: Ragtag
episodes.summary: In the last episode before the epic season finale, Ward's betrayal and HYDRA's shocking secrets are revealed as Coulson's team goes undercover on a mission that leaves no one unscathed.

episodes.title: Beginning of the End
episodes.summary: Dark secrets are revealed as Coulson and his team put everything on the line to stop Garrett and the forces of HYDRA.

episodes.title: Shadows
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team are now wanted fugitives with limited resources -- but that's not stopping them from keeping the world safe from powerful and unseen threats everywhere. However, with new members they hardly know, will S.H.I.E.L.D. ever be trusted again?

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Head
episodes.summary: Hunted and running out of solutions, Coulson puts his team right in the line of fire in the hopes of saving them all. But with General Talbot, Hydra and Creel all on the attack, can they possibly survive? Meanwhile, a mysterious Doctor harbors some dangerous secrets that could destroy one of our core team members.

episodes.title: Making Friends and Influencing People
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team race against Hydra to get to Donnie Gill -- a dangerous gifted with the ability to freeze objects -- while Simmons is caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Face My Enemy
episodes.summary: While on a mission to learn more about the secrets of the mysterious writing, Coulson finds himself attacked by the only person he can trust: Agent Melinda May. Meanwhile, the rest of the team is trapped in an explosive situation, and it's up to Fitz to save them -- but is he up to it?

episodes.title: A Hen in the Wolf House
episodes.summary: Coulson's team is up against the beautiful and deadly Bobbi Morse -- Security Chief for Hydra. Meanwhile, Skye's father forces Raina to reunite him with his daughter at any cost.

episodes.title: A Fractured House
episodes.summary: The world turns against S.H.I.E.L.D. when Hydra impersonates them to attack The United Nations, and an unexpected enemy leads the charge to bring about their downfall.

episodes.title: The Writing on the Wall
episodes.summary: The team discovers murder victims with the alien glyphs on them that Coulson's been etching. All of Coulson's secrets and lies come to a head.

episodes.title: The Things We Bury
episodes.summary: Coulson and team find themselves in an epic face-off against Hydra to uncover an ancient secret, while Ward kidnaps his brother, Senator Christian Ward, for a violent trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: ...Ye Who Enter Here
episodes.summary: Discovers the ancient city before Hydra, but uncovering the secrets may require one of Coulson's team to make the ultimate sacrifice. Meanwhile, May and Skye race to get to Raina before Whitehall takes her.

episodes.title: What They Become
episodes.summary: Coulson and Whitehall's forces meet in an explosive confrontation that dramatically alters everyone's fates. Meanwhile, Skye discovers shocking secrets about her past, on the Winter finale.

episodes.title: Aftershocks
episodes.summary: In the midseason premiere, "Aftershocks," Coulson's team must deal with the consequences of their war with Hydra as shocking revelations threaten to tear them apart, and Hydra makes a dangerous move that may involve a traitor in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s midst.

episodes.title: Who You Really Are
episodes.summary: Coulson and team come to the aid of a confused Lady Sif, who has lost her memory after fighting with a mysterious warrior, whose true mission will send shockwaves through S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mac continue to hide their true mission from everyone close to them.

episodes.title: One of Us
episodes.summary: Cal seeks revenge on Coulson by assembling a team of Super Villains to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, May calls on renowned Dr. Andrew Garner, her charismatic ex-husband, with a crisis that threatens to tear the team apart.

episodes.title: Love in the Time of HYDRA
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team are still reeling from a shocking revelation that leaves the team fractured as they must decide what to do with one of their own. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack reveal their true allegiance to Hunter, while elsewhere, Ward and Agent 33 embark on a personal mission.

episodes.title: One Door Closes
episodes.summary: War comes to Coulson's doorstep in a way he never anticipated as shocking revelations are brought to light, and Skye struggles to control her new abilities but will soon make a decision that irrevocably changes her life.

episodes.title: Afterlife
episodes.summary: As Robert Gonzales makes his move, Coulson must do whatever it takes to protect the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Skye's journey to control her powers takes a surprising turn when she meets the enigmatic Inhuman named Lincoln.

episodes.title: Melinda
episodes.summary: The story of Melinda May's transformation into "The Cavalry" is revealed as she finds herself at a crossroads in the war between Coulson and Gonzales. As Skye learns more about her true heritage from Lincoln, the truth about the Inhumans will send her in a new direction.

episodes.title: The Frenemy of My Enemy
episodes.summary: Dangerous new alliance is formed as Coulson and Hunter turn to the last person anyone would expect - Grant Ward! As the war between S.H.I.E.L.D. factions continues, Skye and Lincoln will find themselves drawn into this conflict.

episodes.title: The Dirty Half Dozen
episodes.summary: Gonzales and Coulson must find a way to put their differences aside and work together against Hydra, even if it means teaming up with someone they don't trust.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.summary: Skye is torn between her loyalty to S.H.I.E.L.D. and her connection to the Inhumans as tensions rise between the groups -- and Coulson reveals a secret he's been hiding from even those closest to him.

episodes.title: S.O.S.: Part 1
episodes.summary: In Part 1 of the two-part second-season finale, sacrifices are made by Agent Coulson and his team in order to get through a war, and relationships are permanently altered as a result.

episodes.title: S.O.S.: Part 2
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team launch a last-ditch attack on the helicarrier to stop Jiaying from unleashing the Terrigen crystals and wiping out S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.title: Laws of Nature
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team track down an outbreak of Inhumans and discover that someone is killing or capturing many of them... and it's not who they think. Meanwhile, Fitz takes desperate steps to recover Jemma, and Daisy and Mack ask Lincoln for help.

episodes.title: Purpose in the Machine
episodes.summary: The team turn to Asgardian Elliott Randolph for help deciphering the monolith and rescuring Jemma. Meanwhile, Grant abducts a key player in his quest to rebuild Hydra, while Lance begins his quest to find--and kill--Grant.

episodes.title: A Wanted (Inhu)man
episodes.summary: The ATCU launches a public alert to bring Lincoln in, and he reluctantly turns to Daisy for help when he realizes that he's in over his head. Meanwhile, Rosalind and Coulson negotiate a deal, and Lance and Melinda take the first step to infiltrating Hydra.

episodes.title: Devils You Know
episodes.summary: S.H.I.E.L.D. and the ATCU get a lead on the mysterious Inhuman killer, Lash. Meanwhile, Lance prepares for a face-to-face meeting with Grant, and Melinda turns to Coulson and Andrew for help.

episodes.title: 4,722 Hours
episodes.summary: Jemma tells Fitz how she survived on the alien planet for six and a half months... and who helped her.

episodes.title: Among Us Hide…
episodes.summary: While Melinda recruits Bobbi to help her find Werner after his attack on Andrew, Lance joins Daisy and Mack to confirm if Rosalind's man Banks is the mysterious Lash. Meanwhiile, Fitz and Jemma continue to try and bring Will home.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory
episodes.summary: Melinda realizes who--and what--Andrew really is and confronts him. Meanwhile, Coulson has Daisy give Rosalind a tour of the Zephyr, and Lincoln reaches out to Mack for help.

episodes.title: Many Heads, One Tale
episodes.summary: Having gained Rosalind's trust, Coulson distracts her with a tour of the base while the rest of the team breaks into the ATCU headquarters to learn about the Inhumans they have captured and their attempts at a cure. Meanwhile,Grant learns the true secret of Hydra.

episodes.title: Closure
episodes.summary: After Grant strikes at Coulson through someone close to him, Coulson swears revenge and goes after the only thing that Grant cares about. Meanwhile, Mack takes command of S.H.I.E.L.D., and Jemma and Fitz are captured during a reconaissance mission.

episodes.title: Maveth
episodes.summary: Mack and his team invade the Hydra castle in the hopes of bringing Fitz and Coulson back through the portal. Meanwhile, on the alien world Grant's team find Will and Fitz convinces him to lead them to the extraction point.

episodes.title: Bouncing Back
episodes.summary: President Ellis sanctions Coulson to continue leading S.H.I.E.L.D. to deal with the Inhuman power. Meanwhile, Malick discovers that his new guest can speak, and Daisy's team encounters two new Inhumans in Bogota.

episodes.title: The Inside Man
episodes.summary: Coulson and a reluctant Talbot attend an international symposium on the Inhumans, and discover a traitor in their midst. Meanwhile, the team meets Talbot's new bodyguard, who may provide a vaccine against Terrigenesis.

episodes.title: Parting Shot
episodes.summary: A mission in Russia goes bad, and Bobbi and Lance are captured. To stop a coup and save S.H.I.E.L.D., the couple must make the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Watchdogs
episodes.summary: A group calling themselves the Watchdogs vows to take out any Inhumans that they can find. They begin their campaign of terror by taking out an ATCu facility, but the team soon learn that the Watchdogs are a front for Hydra.

episodes.title: Spacetime
episodes.summary: Daisy tries to stop a future that she foresees due to an Inhuman's power. Meanwhile, Hive gives Gideon a taste of true power, and Giyera chooses sides.

episodes.title: Paradise Lost
episodes.summary: Hive calls a meeting of Hydra's inner circle to show them his true face... and to teach Gideon a lesson in loyalty. Meanwhile, Daisy and Lincoln contact a former Afterlife resident who has information on Hive, while the others investigate Hydra's newest purchase.

episodes.title: The Team
episodes.summary: Daisy's secret warriors rescue Coulson and his people from Hydra. However, when they return to base with a captive Gideon, Coulson realizes that there may be a traitor among them.

episodes.title: The Singularity
episodes.summary: While Coulson, Melinda, and Lincoln try to recover Daisy, Fitz, Jemma, and Mack go after a scientist who may hold the key to stopping Hive.

episodes.title: Failed Experiments
episodes.summary: Coulson sends a strike team to eliminate Hive before he poses a danger to the world. Meanwhile, Mack tries to save Daisy, and Lincoln insists on taking the anti-toxin that Fitz-Simmons has created to defeat Hive's parasites.

episodes.title: Emancipation
episodes.summary: After the Accords are passed, Coulson brings Talbot to the S.H.I.E.L.D. base to take inventory of their Inhumans. Meanwhile, Daisy helps Lincoln escape while Holden discovers the process to create Inhuman Primitives.

episodes.title: Absolution
episodes.summary: S.H.I.E.L.D. manages to stop the missile launch and capture Hive... only to discover that he's exactly where he wants to be. Meanwhile, Daisy tries to deal with the guilt of what she's done.

episodes.title: Ascension
episodes.summary: One of the team will have to sacrifice themselves to stop Hive from spreading the pathogen across the world.

episodes.title: The Ghost
episodes.summary: After the Sokovia Accords, S.H.I.E.L.D. is under new management. Jemma is advising the new Director, Coulson and Mack are in the field, Melinda is training an elite strike force, and Daisy has gone rogue taking down Watchdog resources. She comes across a mysterious serial killer known as "Ghost Rider" who is apparently the Spirit of Vengeance.... and will stop at nothing to get his grisly revenge.

episodes.title: Meet the New Boss
episodes.summary: Daisy tracks down Robbie and demands answers. Meanwhile, Fitz and Mack get a lead on the ghost that emerged from the box, and discover that there are more than one.

episodes.title: Uprising
episodes.summary: A group claiming to be the Inhumans Resistance launches a series of blackouts across the globe. Jeffrey suspects something more is going on and sends Coulson, Mack, and Fitz to investigate. Meanwhile, Daisy learns more about Robbie and his brother Gabe, and Jemma and Holden struggle to save Melinda's life.

episodes.title: Let Me Stand Next to Your Fire
episodes.summary: Daisy turns to Jemma for help, while Mack and Coulson pay a visit to Robbie's uncle Eli and encounter Ghost Rider. Meanwhile, Holden and Fitz use Melinda to test to see if Aida can pass as human.

episodes.title: Lockup
episodes.summary: Coulson and his people break into prison to free Eli before Lucy finds him. Meanwhile, Jeffrey goes before the nation to debate Senator Nadeer about the Inhuman issue.

episodes.title: The Good Samaritan
episodes.summary: How Robbie became Ghost Rider is revealed, after Jeffrey boards the Quinjet looking for Robbie and Daisy. Meanwhile, Lucy forces Eli to reveal the secrets of the Darkhold.

episodes.title: Deals with Our Devils
episodes.summary: Coulson, Fitz, and Robbie disappear and their teammates assume that they're dead... unaware that they're out of phase, intangible, and invisible. Meanwhile, Mack loses hope and the vengeance demon seeks a now host.

episodes.title: The Laws of Inferno Dynamics
episodes.summary: When Eli creates a nuclear bomb using his new powers, Fitz realizes where he is getting his energies from... and that they threaten to destroy LA. The team has to take Eli down before it's too late, but Eli manages to take Ghost Rider out of commission.

episodes.title: Broken Promises
episodes.summary: Jemma confirms Vijay's identity, and she, Jeffrey, and Daisy go to rescue him from his sister and the Watchdogs. Meanwhile, Aida attacks S.H.I.E.L.D. HQ in an attempt to obtain the Darkhold.

episodes.title: The Patriot
episodes.summary: After an attempt on Jeffrey's life, Coulson and Mack escort him to safety... and discover the secret of his Inhuman abilities. Meanwhile, Fitz promises the decapitated Aida that he'll try to restore her, and Melinda wakes up in Holden's apartment.

episodes.title: Wake Up
episodes.summary: Coulson authorizes a mission to bug Nadeer's office against Talbot's advice, but things go bad. Meanwhile, Holden finds the key to keeping Melinda imprisoned, and Fitz finds out what his friend is up to.

episodes.title: Hot Potato Soup
episodes.summary: The Superior and his men abduct Billy Koenig to get the location of the Darkhold from him. While Coulson and his field team go after Sam, Fitz, Jemma, and Mack deal with the Holden LMD that they captured.

episodes.title: BOOM
episodes.summary: The Superior sends Terrence to trigger Terragenesis in Nadeer, believing that she's an Inhuman. However, they all got an explosive surprise. Meanwhile, Coulson and Mack track down the woman that Aida's appearance was based on and try to use her to find Melinda.

episodes.title: The Man Behind the Shield
episodes.summary: The team follows a series of clues left by the Superior designed to bring them to their opponent's base... and the trap that he's set for them.

episodes.title: Self Control
episodes.summary: Fitz and Jemma realize that they may be the only senior staff that haven't been replaced with LMDs. Meanwhile, Aida makes her own plans to protect the Framework.

episodes.title: What If...
episodes.summary: Jemma and Daisy discover that things have gone horribly wrong in the Framework, when they realize that Hydra now rules the world and ruthlessly hunts down and exterminates Inhumans.

episodes.title: Identity and Change
episodes.summary: While Daisy tries to get Holden's location via Hydra's databases, Coulson and Jemma meet with the head of the resistance. Meanwhile, Aida tells Fitz her version of the truth about the Framework.

episodes.title: No Regrets
episodes.summary: Coulson and Jeffrey break into an Enlightenment Center to rescue a prisoner with valuable information about Project Looking Glass. Meanwhile, Fitz meets with an unexpected ally, and Jemma tries to convince Grant and Jeffrey that their world isn't real.

episodes.title: All the Madame's Men
episodes.summary: Daisy and Melinda escape the Triskelion and go on the run from Hydra. Meanwhile, Jemma realizes what Aida has planned, and Holden tells Alistair who he is in the real world.

episodes.title: Farewell, Cruel World!
episodes.summary: Daisy and Jemma take the team to the backdoor, only to discover that Aida has anticipated them. Meanwhile, Fitz discovers that his father is dead and who is responsible, and sets out to exact vengeance.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.summary: While Coulson and Melinda try to escape the rig, Jemma and Daisy find themselves under attack. Meanwhile, Aida revels in the joys of becoming human.

episodes.title: World's End
episodes.summary: Aida sets out to destroy the world with the help of the Darkhold, and only Ghost Rider can stop her. Meanwhile, S.H.I.E.L.D. is framed for weaponizing the Inhumans and the authorities close in on the team.

episodes.title: Orientation (Part One)
episodes.summary: The team finds themselves on a mysterious outpost in space surrounded by corpses, and with no sign of Fitz. As they meet the inhabitants, the agents try to work out where they are.

episodes.title: Orientation (Part Two)
episodes.summary: As they come to their grips with their new surroundings, Coulson, Mack, and Elena are forced to make a deal with a crime lord, Grill. Meanwhile, Jemma is captured by the Kree, and Daisy discovers who was responsible for Earth's fate.

episodes.title: A Life Spent
episodes.summary: While Daisy tries to rescue Jemma, Coulson and his team search the rubble belt for a mysterious segment. Meanwhile, Jemma coaches a young Inhuman in her powers.

episodes.title: A Life Earned
episodes.summary: Kasius tells Daisy what her value is to him. Meanwhile, Grill tasks Mack with acting as his new enforcer, and Coulson and Melinda discover that Deke isn't being honest with them.

episodes.title: Rewind
episodes.summary: Fitz is left behind and the military locks him up. He soon plots an escape, and works out a way to travel to the future to rescue his friends.

episodes.title: Fun & Games
episodes.summary: Fitz makes contact with Jemma and tries to plan an escape. Meanwhile, the human teenagers undergo Terrigenesis and one of them reveals his new power.

episodes.title: Together or Not at All
episodes.summary: Faulnak sends his best hunter to recover Daisy, while Daisy, Fitz, and Jemma try to reunite with Coulson and the others. On the surface, Melinda meets Enoch.

episodes.title: The Last Day
episodes.summary: Coulson and the others meet up with the surface survivors, while Mack, Elena, and Flint battle the Roaches that Kasius has unleashed on the Lighthouse humans.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.summary: While Elena and Mack rally the humans to fight against Kasius, Coulson and the others try to find a way to return to the Lighthouse while Sinara comes looking for Daisy.

episodes.title: Past Life
episodes.summary: As Deke and Enoch prepare to open the time portal, Elena discovers who Kasius' Seer is while Daisy refuses to go back to 2018 and end up destroying the planet.

episodes.title: All the Comforts of Home
episodes.summary: Coulson and team return to 2018 and discover that they're fugitives from the government. A mysterious woman leads the government forces, and sets off a chain of events that may lead to the future that the team experienced.

episodes.title: The Real Deal
episodes.summary: The team discovers what Coulson has been hiding from them, as the monoliths' explosion causes a rift to a fear dimension that threatens to destroy them all.

episodes.title: Principia
episodes.summary: The team gets a lead on the Gravitonium they need to seal the rift once and for all. Meanwhile, Deke learns who his grandparents are, while Hale and Ruby recruit another member to their team.

episodes.title: The Devil Complex
episodes.summary: Fitz tries to seal the rift, and what appears to be his greatest fear materializes to help him. Meanwhile, Coulson and Melinda capture Hale only to discover that it's a trap.

episodes.title: Rise and Shine
episodes.summary: Hale's history with Hydra is revealed as she tries to convince Coulson to join forces with her. Meanwhile, Fitz asks for his freedom so that he can help find out why Hale wants their leader.

episodes.title: Inside Voices
episodes.summary: Coulson convinces one of Hale's people to help him. Meanwhile, Jemma and Elena come up with a plan to free Fitz, while Daisy and Melinda turn to Robin for help.

episodes.title: The Honeymoon
episodes.summary: Deke is injured trying to help Daisy, while Fitzsimmons and Elena discover what Hale has planned. Meanwhile, Melinda makes a confession to Coulson.

episodes.title: All Roads Lead…
episodes.summary: Daisy benches Coulson and takes a team to stop Ruby before she becomes the Destroyer of Worlds.

episodes.title: Option Two
episodes.summary: Qovas sends his men to get the Gravitonium, and finds a team torn apart by suspicion and distrust of each other... and no sign of Daisy.

episodes.title: The One Who Will Save Us All
episodes.summary: Talbot and Coulson go to negotiate with the Confederacy, while Daisy has Jemma find a way to make the Centipede technology work.

episodes.title: The Force of Gravity
episodes.summary: While Talbot pays his family a visit, Coulson and Melinda try to find a way off of the Confederacy spaceship.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.summary: A member of the team dies while trying to stop Talbot, who is intent on acquiring enough Gravitonium to fight Thanos. Meanwhile, the agents try to deal with Coulson's impending death.

episodes.title: Missing Pieces
episodes.summary: Daisy, Jemma, Piper, and Davis search the galaxy for Fitz. On Earth, Mac continues his command of S.H.I.E.L.D. as a series of dimensional anomalies spring up across the planet.

episodes.title: Window of Opportunity
episodes.summary: Sarge and his crew seek out a vital component to their plan, and S.H.I.E.L.D. slowly learns of their intentions while pursuing them. Fitz's position as an engineer on the Sivian ship is threatened... along with his life.

episodes.title: Fear and Loathing on the Planet of Kitson
episodes.summary: Daisy and her team track Fitz and Enoch to Kitson, where the unlikely duo have lost their ship and are trying to make enough money gambling to get off the planet.

episodes.title: Code Yellow
episodes.summary: What Deke has been up to is revealed, and he discovers that Sarge and his crew are after him. Meanwhile, Keller is infected by an alien parasite and Yo-Yo and Marcus try to save his life.

episodes.title: The Other Thing
episodes.summary: Sarge demonstrates to Miranda the magnitude of the threat Earth faces. Marcus gets a clue to the parasites' plans in Yucatan, and Enoch betrays his best friend.

episodes.title: Inescapable
episodes.summary: Atarah traps Fitz and Jemma in a mind prison and the only way out is for them to find a way for the remaining Chronicoms to travel back through time and save their homeworld. But to do so, the couple must face their inner demons.

episodes.title: Toldja
episodes.summary: Mack questions the captive Sarge, who has plans of his own. Fitz, Jemma, and Enoch return to Kitson and Mr. Kitson has words with them.

episodes.title: Collision Course (Part I)
episodes.summary: Mack sends Melinda, Daisy, and Deke with Sarge and Snowflake, while he holds Jaco and Pax. Meanwhile, Fitz and Jemma begin the journey back to Earth but find something odd going on involving Izel.

episodes.title: Collision Course (Part II)
episodes.summary: Sarge, Jaco, and Pax capture the Zephyr and prepare to go after Izel. The team in the trailer try to stop Sarge's bomb, and Izel questions Fitz-Simmons' loyalty.

episodes.title: Leap
episodes.summary: After Melinda tells Yo-yo that she has no memory of shooting Sarge, a deadly game of hide-and-seek ensues as the team realizes that Izel can possess anyone she wishes.

episodes.title: From the Ashes
episodes.summary: While Deke and Fitz-Simmons try to find a way to negate Izel's powers, Daisy tries to get Sarge to reveal who he truly is and Izel forces Marcus to take her to the temple.

episodes.title: The Sign
episodes.summary: Izel uses Flint's powers to open a gateway to her dimension and bring her people through. Melinda tries to convince Sarge that he's a good person with or without Coulson, and Deke has enough of everyone looking down on him.

episodes.title: New Life
episodes.summary: Melinda battles Izel, Daisy and Mack fight Sarge, and Yo-Yo deals with a problem from within. Fitz-Simmons have to deal with another situation where they have to change the course of their natural lives, and Sarge's true people prepare to invade Earth.

episodes.title: The New Deal
episodes.summary: Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. are thrust backward in time and stranded in 1931 New York City. With the all-new Zephyr set to time-jump at any moment, the team must hurry to find out exactly what happened. If they fail, it would mean disaster for the past, present and future of the world.

episodes.title: Know Your Onions
episodes.summary: With the identity of the timeline-unraveling "thread" revealed, the team's mission to protect him at all costs leads each agent to question their own values.

episodes.title: Alien Commies from the Future!
episodes.summary: A surprise leap forward in time has stranded Enoch in 1931 and landed the team in yet another unfamiliar decade. Now, in order to stop the chronicoms from launching their newest future-dismantling plan, the agents will have to infiltrate one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most secure bases. They won't be able to succeed without help from a familiar face or two.

episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.summary: It was just another average morning on July 22, 1955, when Agent Phil Coulson realized the importance of that day in the S.H.I.E.L.D. history books. With a chip on his shoulder and a genre-bending glitch in his system, he'd set into motion a chain of events that would hopefully preserve the timeline as we know it and ensure those pesky chronicoms get the ending they deserve. What could go wrong?

episodes.title: A Trout in the Milk
episodes.summary: After a bumpy landing in the disco decade, the team – Daniel Sousa in tow – reunites with more than one familiar face at the S.H.I.E.L.D. hangout and discovers exactly how to dismantle the Chronicoms' latest plan. But when they get too close for comfort, the Zephyr unexpectedly leaps forward again, this time to a date pivotal to not only the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. but to the future of Director Mack as well.

episodes.title: Adapt or Die
episodes.summary: The team must scramble to rescue Mack's parents, save S.H.I.E.L.D. from a chronicom infestation and fix the ship, all before the next time-jump. Meanwhile, Daisy and Sousa find themselves at a disadvantage against a power hungry Nathaniel Malick and his goons, and Coulson will have to do the thing he does best in order to save the future.

episodes.title: The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and the D
episodes.summary: After being unexpectedly stranded in 1982, Mack retreats to his childhood home to process the death of his parents, while Deke gets to work scouting a chart-topping group of new agents. With no idea if or when the team is coming back for them, time seems to finally be on their side ... at least until the killer robots show up.

episodes.title: After, Before
episodes.summary: With the Zephyr's time drive malfunctioning, the team is quite literally hurling toward disaster and Yo-Yo may be their only hope. The only problem? To get her powers back, she'll need to enlist the help of an old adversary and revisit part of her past long hidden away.

episodes.title: As I Have Always Been
episodes.summary: A time storm ravages the Zephyr, propelling it toward destruction while simultaneously forcing Daisy and Coulson to relive their failed attempts to save the team over and over, until they find a solution or are swallowed by the storm. Making it to their next destination will take trust, courage and sacrifice from everyone on board, but it will all come down to having enough time.

episodes.title: Stolen
episodes.summary: After Enoch's sacrifice propelled them out of the time storm, the team arrives back in 1983 where Nathanial and Kora are hard at work building an army of hand-selected anarchist Inhumans at Afterlife. When the agents split up to cover more ground, Daisy is tasked with protecting Jiaying and is compelled to confront her mother for the first time since her death; while the others quickly learn they'll need to face yet another supercharged former enemy in order to stop Malick.

episodes.title: Brand New Day
episodes.summary: With the help of Kora on the inside, Sibyl and Nathanial continue their fight to shape a dark new future for S.H.I.E.L.D., managing to stay one step ahead of the agents along the way. If the team is going to turn this one around, they'll have to get creative, and maybe even a little out of this world.

episodes.title: The End Is at Hand
episodes.summary: With their backs against the wall and Nathaniel and Sibyl edging ever closer to eliminating S.H.I.E.L.D. from the history books, the agents must rely on their strengths to outsmart and outlast the Chronicoms. This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.

episodes.title: What We're Fighting For
episodes.summary: This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.
